facility.name: Trinity Advance Learning Center
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 2005 LAWNDALE AVE, VICTORIA, TX, 77901

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: A caregiver did not wash an infants hands after their diaper was changed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child: One caregiver did not wash their hands after changing an infant.  Note: This was corrected  at the time of the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area: A caregiver did not sanitize the changing table after changing an infant.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area (26 TAC §746.3505(e))

occurrences.finding: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes: One infant was observed in a restrictive device for 17 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes (26 TAC §746.2417(2)(B))

occurrences.finding: Franchise Tax Delinquent: According to the Texas Comptroller website, the business entity's Franchise Tax Account Status is Inactive/Forfeited. The operation is currently providing care to children with an inactive status.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Franchise Tax Delinquent (26 TAC §745.247)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: During the course of an DFPS investigation, it was determined that multiple caregivers did not demonstrate self-control which resulted in caregivers engaging in physical altercations in front of children. The caregivers involved in the altercation also used foul language in front of the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations: One out of ten children files lacked current immunizations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations (26 TAC §746.613(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912): Three out of ten employees files lacked the pre employment affidavit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.901(5))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - Used According to Manufacturer's Instructions: An 3 month old infant was observed in a bouncer that was placed in a crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - Used According to Manufacturer's Instructions (26 TAC §746.4601(2))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The last fire inspection was conducted in August of 2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: An 11 month old was observed sleeping in a crib with a blanket.   NOTE: The blanket was removed at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: Three out of seven personnel files lacked the required 6 topics.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: A child under two years old was observed watching television.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited: During the course of a DFPS investigation, it was determined that neglectful supervision occurred when a child exited the operation and was observed walking by himself next to a busy intersection.  The operation was unaware that he had left his group or the facility until they were notified by an individual who found the child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited (26 TAC §746.1201(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: Operation staff failed to ensure that they communicated that a child was being moved from one classroom group to another, resulting in a child's absence from the program being overlooked by staff.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers (26 TAC §746.1203(10))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: Children in the 18 month- 24 month room were sitting in high chairs watching a tablet while the caregiver changed diapers.             Note: This was corrected when the caregiver turned the screen around so children would just be able to listen and not watch the screen.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: Infant feeding instructions were not followed when a caregiver feed a 5 month old infant baby food and also allowing a baby to go 8 hours without a bottle.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: A caregiver exercised poor judgement when they failed to seek assistance or notify the parent when an infant in care refused to consume any bottles for an eight-hour period.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Infant Daily Report - Share with Parent: An infant daily report was not shared to a parent at the end of the day.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Daily Report - Share with Parent (26 TAC §746.2431)

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Prompt Attention to Needs: A 5-month-old infant physical needs were not meet when the infant did not consume a bottle in an eight-hour period.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Prompt Attention to Needs (26 TAC §746.2401(4))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Two out of ten children files lacked current and up to date immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: The Director lacked current transportation training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: On the playground there are nails sticking out of the wood. The playground has wood that has rooted away and has sharp edges. In one classroom there was a bucket of water accessible to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: Nine out of eleven personnel files checked had CPR completed online. CPR must be completed in person .
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers - Pre-service Training: One caregiver lacked 9 hours of professional development.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers - Pre-service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: HRC42.056(g) - BGC-persons cannot provide direct care/have direct access to children without all required background checks unless they meet certain criteria.: A caregiver at the operation did not have the correct background check to be left alone with children unsupervised or be counted in ratio.
occurrences.violation_type_title: HRC42.056(g) - BGC-persons cannot provide direct care/have direct access to children without all required background checks unless they meet certain criteria. (26 TAC §HRC42.056(g) - BGC-persons cannot provid)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Four out ten of files children files lacked the physician statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Two out of ten children files were lacking emergency contact address and telephones numbers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Directors 30- Annual Training: The director lacked 10.5 hours of annual training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Directors 30- Annual Training (26 TAC §746.1301(6)(A))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: Two classrooms had cleaning supplies accessible to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Vaccine Preventable Diseases: The operational policies lacked information regarding vaccines for employees.     Note: This was corrected when information regarding vaccines for employees was added to the operational policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Vaccine Preventable Diseases (26 TAC §746.501(a)(28))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The last fire inspection was conducted on 4/30/2021.     Note: The fire inspection was scheduled during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual: Based on information gathered, caregivers have grabbed children as a form of punishment and tell children to fight each other.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)

occurrences.finding: Infant Daily Report - Share with Parent: Based on observations and interviews conducted, infant parents are not provided with an infant daily report each day.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Daily Report - Share with Parent (26 TAC §746.2431)

occurrences.finding: Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance - Brief Supervised Separation: A caregiver admitted to making school age children sit in time out for five to fifteen minutes at a time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance - Brief Supervised Separation (26 TAC §746.2803(4)(D))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Withholding Active Play: A caregiver admitted to withholding active play for children who continued to misbehave while inside.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Withholding Active Play (26 TAC §746.2805(9))

occurrences.finding: Operation Open to Parents At All Times: Based on evidence gathered, some parents are not allowed inside of their child's classroom to observe their child. They have been told they have to remain in the foyer area and are not allowed in the classrooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Operation Open to Parents At All Times (26 TAC §746.201(7))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: Based on information gathered, caregivers have yelled at children as a form of punishment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(6))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children: School age children were observed going to the bathroom, which is located outside of the classroom unsupervised.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: Operation allowed two people to be present at the operation before receiving notice from the CBCU regarding the person's eligibility.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area - Not Used as a Passageway: An infant classroom is being used as a passageway for older children to get to their room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area - Not Used as a Passageway (26 TAC §746.2403(6))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: Two infants were observed in a high chair and a bumbo. Safety straps were not used.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Notification of Change in Space: The operation failed to notify licensing of a change of space for infants.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Notification of Change in Space (26 TAC §746.301(2))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - No Long Waiting Periods: The school age children and infant 12m-17m old room were observed with an hour waiting period before any activities were completed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - No Long Waiting Periods (26 TAC §746.2205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Review list and Remove unsafe products: A rock-n-play was observed in the 12m-17m old room.    Note: This was corrected when the rock-n-play was removed from the room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Review list and Remove unsafe products (26 TAC §746.4135(a))

occurrences.finding: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes: Infants were observed in a high chair for approximately one hour.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes (26 TAC §746.2417(2)(B))

occurrences.finding: Infant Daily Report - Share with Parent: Infant daily reports are not being completed for the 12m-17 month old room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Daily Report - Share with Parent (26 TAC §746.2431)

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: Child/caregiver ratio was not maintained as staff were observed walking out of the classroom, leaving the other caregiver out of ratio.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Infant monthly feeding schedules were observed not being updated for the month.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))
